info.title: AI Education Innovation Radar Ingestion API
info.description: Secure ingestion endpoint for logging newly detected global educational innovation signals into the BeLEARN / PHBern AI Education Innovation Radar.

post.summary: Ingest one or more curated educational innovation signals into the Radar database
post.description: Takes verified innovation signals from global research, university pilots, and educational initiatives. Stores them with decoupled novelty, maturity, evidence level and exploratory Swiss translation hypotheses.

signals.description: List of innovation signals to ingest

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid Bearer token.

title.description: Clear, informative title of the educational innovation

summary.description: Concise 1-2 sentence description of what the innovation does and how it operates

source_url.description: Verifiable URL of the primary publication, report, or institution pilot page

source_name.description: Originating organization or journal (e.g. EDUCAUSE, OECD, EPFL, UNESCO)

country.description: Country name where the pilot/innovation originated

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. CH, US, SG, FI, DE, EE)

latitude.description: Approximate latitude of the origin city

longitude.description: Approximate longitude of the origin city

innovation_type.description: Category: Pedagogy, Learning Environment, Assessment, Teacher Support, Literacy, etc.

educational_problem.description: Specific structural or didactical challenge being addressed

target_groups.description: Applicable learner cohorts: Primary, Sekundarstufe I, Sekundarstufe II, Higher Education, Vocational Education, Teacher Education

novelty.description: 1 (incremental) to 5 (paradigm shift). Kept strictly decoupled from maturity and evidence.

evidence_summary.description: Concise summary of verified empirical findings without exaggerated claims

swiss_relevance.description: Analysis of relevance to Swiss education (Lehrplan 21 / dual VET / cantonal autonomy)

swiss_application_hypothesis.description: Exploratory application hypothesis for testing in Swiss schools or PHBern

limitations.description: Known risks, operational bottlenecks, or context dependencies
